# Granton Finance

> Commercial finance broking for UK limited companies, led by a chartered management accountant. We arrange acquisition, management buyout, succession and refinance funding — and pre-underwrite each deal the way a credit committee reads it before it goes to any lender. Granton Finance is a trading name of Edwards Bros (Spaldwick) Ltd, a family company trading since 1955, based in Cambridgeshire.

Granton Finance is led by Peter Edwards ACMA CGMA, a chartered management accountant and former finance director. The difference from a typical broker is the order of work: the numbers are read and the case structured before it reaches a lender, rather than shopping an application around.

Regulatory position: Granton Finance introduces limited-company clients to commercial lenders and is remunerated by commission, disclosed in writing before any drawdown. This is general commercial-finance introduction for business-to-business unregulated lending, not regulated financial advice. We do not advise on or arrange consumer credit. Member of the Finance and Intermediary Broker Association (FIBA), membership number FIB42279. Company number 00598511. ICO registration ZA900683.

## What we arrange

Specialisms — the structuring-heavy deals:

- Acquisition finance: buying a business or a competitor.
- Management buyout (MBO) finance: buying out a co-owner, a family member or the existing owner.
- Succession finance: funding the next generation or an existing management team to take over.

Also arranged:

- Commercial mortgages: buying premises, refinancing, funding development.
- Asset and equipment finance: machinery, vehicles and equipment.
- Invoice finance: releasing cash held in unpaid invoices.
- Business loans: unsecured funding for growth or working capital.

## Tools

- [Deal Fundability Score](https://granton.finance/score): A free eight-question self-check giving an indicative read on how fundable a business purchase, buyout or succession deal is, and what would strengthen it. Answers stay in the browser; nothing is sent unless the user chooses to email the result. Indicative only — not a credit decision or an offer of finance.
